title: Concierge
hero_prompt: A wide Art Nouveau lithograph poster in the manner of Mucha: a poised man at a plain, uncarved open doorway holding a lantern, threads of light trailing back into the dark hall behind him, flat bold colour fields and flowing ink outlines. Hand-made Art Nouveau lithograph poster, with visible ink, brush or print texture on paper; flat and graphic, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no glossy highlights.
icon_prompt: A bold Art Nouveau-style emblem of a single lantern silhouette set in a doorway arch, thick flat black shape on a light ground, no fine ornament, reading clearly as a strong mark at small size.
